```javascript
const request = require('supertest');

      .expect(res => {
        res.body.forEach(user => {
          expect(user).to.not.have.property('email');
        });
      })
      .expect(200, done);
  });

  it('should handle 404 gracefully', (done) => {
    request(app)
      .get('/nonexistent')
      .expect(404, done);
  });
});
```

```bash
NODE_ENV=test mocha test/security.test.js
```

